_comment: Mission 1, act 1. See MISSION_01.md for the whole act and what is still missing. Only the boarding cutscene exists so far.
title: THE BOARDING

boarding._comment: Four pirates move from the airlock they came in through to the crew quarters. This is the movement half of the beat only - striking the crew and dragging them to the hold needs poses that are not authored yet, and is deliberately not faked here. See MISSION_01.md C2 and C3.
boarding._timing_note: Seconds from the start of the cutscene. Walk durations are not written here: the simulation charges distance divided by speed along the real corridors, so a beat says when someone sets off and 'wait_until_still' says when the timeline may continue.

beats._note: Both pairs break for the quarters at once, from opposite ends of the ship.
Nothing further until every one of them has arrived.

boarding._staging_note: Where actors stand when the cutscene starts, which is not where the mission starts them. The pirates come in through the airlock; by the time the player takes control they have spread out to the cockpit and the quarters, which is what data/scene_rescue.json places them at.

_placeholder_warning: EVERY LINE BELOW IS PLACEHOLDER. Written to exercise the dialogue system, not to ship. The owner writes the real script; these exist so timing, wrapping, bubble placement and skipping can be judged before a word of it is final. TOCK's lines do follow his rules - no contractions, states probabilities unprompted, says nothing the log has not already said plainly - because a placeholder in the wrong voice tests the wrong line lengths.

cold_open._comment: Act 1 beat 1. TOCK over the intercom, the captain answering from their bunk. Neither has a body in the room, so both are comms panels.

lines.speaker: TOCK
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] Captain. We are being boarded. I counted four of them at the airlock eleven seconds ago.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] What. I was asleep four seconds ago.

lines.speaker: TOCK
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] My monitor says half the crew is already subdued. The probability that you are next is high. I would put it at eighty per cent.

lines.speaker: TOCK
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] I am in my charging pod. They have not looked in here. I do not think they consider me a person.

quarters_bubbles._comment: Act 1, after the boarding cutscene. Bubbles over people standing in the ship, to test anchoring and the tail. Anyone whose actor id is missing falls back to a comms panel rather than pointing at nothing.

lines.speaker: SMITH
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] Nobody move. Nobody be a hero. That includes me.

lines.speaker: OSTROW
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] Four of them. I have counted worse odds and I did not enjoy those either.

lines.speaker: TOCK
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] I can reach their suit software. It will take three seconds. I am telling you this so that you can decide, not so that you feel better.

lines.speaker: VELA
lines.text: [PLACEHOLDER] Do it, TOCK. I have got a wrench and a bad attitude and that is the whole plan otherwise.
